purpose: Compare calibrated sealed-cell volumes when the experiment reports net transient water transport rather than holding the humidity change below five percentage points.

transient.note: Ten percentage points is a comparison target for a net-transient experiment, not a constant-boundary constraint.

interpretation.fixed_flux_assumption: All values condition on the base configuration's 208 g/m2/h target flux over the unchanged 25 cm2 active membrane.
interpretation.claim_boundary: The closed cell reports integrated net water movement under evolving humidity conditions. It does not by itself establish a constant-boundary or intrinsic membrane flux.
